digest.component_or_area: LLM gate review workflows and cost economics
propositions: Mean LLM gate cost per completed ticket is 11.85 dollars (median 8.15, p90 21); per-gate breakdown: plan-review 3.02/run, code-review 1.42/run, completion-verifier 2.24/run

Code-review severity axes are functionally inert because blocking is routed before severity is consulted (0.95 threshold unreachable; 7/432 attribute combinations meet it, all requiring blast_radius=system AND likelihood=high AND reversibility=hard with zero real occurrences)

Cheap-model experiments (Nova Pro, Haiku, Nova 2 Lite) identified viable frontier swaps and deterministic lever candidates; Nova Pro disqualified for completion-verify false-accepts; Haiku and Sonnet rank highest by accuracy
Deprecation registry analysis found nothing with expired removal conditions; single-pass review surfaces and REBAR_LLM_MODEL are v0.11.0-recent candidates for a future pre-1.0 breaking window

CloudWatch metrics observability.sh has two defects fabricating false-positive alarms: cold-start seeding (widespread-zealous-narwhal) and over-broad unanchored grep matching LLM output as error markers (colossal-slothful-grouse)
Bedrock client-error spike on 2026-08-10/11 (77 errors, 94% on Nova family) traced to output-token ceiling validation; fix deployed as e800, but DeepSeek model untested for same ceiling compliance
